scoring_method.reason: Strategy prints a 5-point likelihood scale (Table 2), a 5-point impact scale (Table 1) and a 5x5 matrix giving a score and label per cell (Figure 1) with RAG bands (Table 4).

evaluation_levels.quote: Gross level – likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action.
evaluation_levels.definition: likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action

evaluation_levels.quote: Actual level - this is the current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place but excluding further mitigation action planned.
evaluation_levels.definition: current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation already in place, excluding further planned mitigation

evaluation_levels.quote: Expected level – this is a future level of likelihood and impact based on any additional mitigation action (if any) planned to further address the triggers and the consequences of risks.
evaluation_levels.definition: future likelihood and impact after any additional planned mitigation
